description: This file is the code-behind for the Dashboard page of an Online Examination System, handling page load and button click events to navigate between pages.

classes.name: Dashboard
classes.description: Partial class representing the code-behind for the Dashboard web page, managing navigation actions.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Event handler invoked when the page loads; currently does nothing.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for the home button; currently does nothing.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for the profile button; transfers user to the UserProfile page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for the leaderboard button; transfers user to the Leaderboard page.

methods.name: sExamB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for the start exam button; transfers user to the StartExam page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for the logout button; transfers user to the LoginPage.
